![](images/headshot.jpg){.headshot fig-alt="Brian Stacy"}

Brian Stacy is a Senior Economist in the Office of the Chief Economist for People at the
World Bank. His current work focuses on the Human Capital Index Plus (HCI+), flagship
reports on human development, and a minimum data package for children, adolescents, and
youth. Previously, he served as a data scientist with the Indicators and Data Services
team in the World Bank's Development Data Group, co-leading the Statistical Performance
Indicators project and contributing to the Atlas of Sustainable Development Goals and the
World Development Indicators. He has also worked on the Global Education Policy Dashboard
and Learning Poverty projects in the Education Global Practice.
:::

His research interests include measurement and data gaps, economics of education, labor
markets, nutrition, and poverty. He holds a Ph.D. in Economics from Michigan State
University.
